attchmntText: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "Press Release   Performance Review of Q2 & H1 FY27 - GRSE Strengthens Financial Performance, Registers Impressive Growth in Q2 & H1 FY27".
voiceSummary: Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers Limited filed a press release regarding its financial performance for the second quarter and half of fiscal year 2027. The company reported total income of Rs 1886 crore for Q2 FY27, reflecting an 8% year-on-year increase. Revenue stood at Rs 1827 crore, up 9% compared to the same period last year. Profit after tax reached Rs 172 crore, marking a 12% growth. For the first half of FY27, total income was Rs 3800 crore, with revenue at Rs 3641 crore. Profit after tax for the half-year was Rs 345 crore, showing a 26% increase. The earnings per share for Q2 FY27 were Rs 15.01. The announcement includes details on new vessel launches and infrastructure projects.

attchmntText: Unaudited Financial Results along with the Limited Review Report for the Quarter and Half Year Ended 30th September, 2026.
voiceSummary: Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers Limited has filed its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited. The Board of Directors approved these results during a meeting held on 11th November 2026, which commenced at 1100 hours and concluded at 1425 hours. The submission includes the statement of assets and liabilities as on 30th September 2026, the statement of cash flow for the half year, and a limited review report from the statutory auditors. Necessary publications of the financial results are being made in English, Hindi, and local daily newspapers.

attchmntText: In terms of Regulation 30 and other applicable provisions of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Company has signed a contract on 02 Nov 2026 for  Construction of Five (5) Next Generation Corvettes (NGCs)  with the Indian Navy in New Delhi at a total value of Rs.32,000 Crore.The details of the Order are enclosed.This is for your information and record.

In continuance of our earlier letter no. GRSE/BD-69/CA/14/25-26 dated 22 May 2025 on the subject matter  GRSE become L1 to NGC Project  and in terms of Regulation 30 and other applicable provisions of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended, we wish to inform you that the Company has signed a contract with the Indian Navy in New Delhi today for the construction of five Next Generation Corvettes (NGCs). The contract, valued at approximately Rs. 32,000 Crore.Copy of the press release is enclosed herewith.This is for your information and record
